math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}\begin{gathered}x\in \left(-\infty, -1\right)\Longrightarrow x^{2} - 2 x - 3\ge0\\\left|x^{2} - 2 x - 3\right|=x^{2} - 2 x - 3\\f(x)=x^{2} - 2 x - 3\end{gathered}\\\begin{gathered}x\in \left[-1, 3\right)\Longrightarrow x^{2} - 2 x - 3\le0\\\left|x^{2} - 2 x - 3\right|=- x^{2} + 2 x + 3\\f(x)=- x^{2} + 2 x + 3\end{gathered}\\\begin{gathered}x\in \left[3, \infty\right)\Longrightarrow x^{2} - 2 x - 3\ge0\\\left|x^{2} - 2 x - 3\right|=x^{2} - 2 x - 3\\f(x)=x^{2} - 2 x - 3\end{gathered}\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: 分区间画出各段图像

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}f(x)=\begin{cases}x^{2} - 2 x - 3,& x\in \left(-\infty, -1\right)\\- x^{2} + 2 x + 3,& x\in \left[-1, 3\right)\\x^{2} - 2 x - 3,& x\in \left[3, \infty\right)\end{cases}\\\bigcup I_i=\mathbb{R},\quad f(x)\ge0\\f(x)=0\Longleftrightarrow x^{2} - 2 x - 3=0\end{gathered}$$
